answer_3.quote: We generate natural language explanations using LLAMA-3.3 70B. Instead of instructing the model to make a shareability decision, we prompt it to assess the overall quality of the Spanish MT relative to the English source text.
methods: natural language explanations of translation quality

answer_4.quote: We conduct a between-subjects human study with 91 English-speaking monolingual participants, where they are asked to decide whether Spanish MT outputs are safe to share with a hypothetical Spanish-speaking neighbor.
answer_4.guideline: To the best of your knowledge, is the Spanish translation good enough to safely share with your Spanish-speaking neighbor? How confident are you in your assessment?
